summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 22, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing two poster presentations on its noninvasive lung cancer diagnostic, CyPath Lung, at the 2026 NAVREF Annual Conference in Arlington, Virginia, September 27-30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is stated. The filing is an ordinary current report covering a product and clinical-data announcement, with no special-situations mechanics or risk-arb angle to monitor.
